description: Defines classes and structures for HPACK header compression tables used in HTTP/2, including static and dynamic tables, header entries, and related operations.

classes.name: HpackStringPair
classes.description: Represents a header name-value pair with size calculation and debug string.

classes.name: HpackDecoderStaticTable
classes.description: Provides access to the static HPACK header table.

classes.name: HpackDecoderDynamicTable
classes.description: Manages the dynamic HPACK header table with insertions and size management.

classes.name: HpackDecoderTables
classes.description: Encapsulates static and dynamic tables, providing methods for size updates, insertions, and lookups.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Calculates size of header entry per RFC.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a debug string representation of the header pair.

methods.name: HpackDecoderStaticTable
methods.description: Constructor for static table, optionally with a custom table.

methods.name: HpackDecoderDynamicTable
methods.description: Constructor, destructor, and methods for size update, insertion, lookup, and eviction.

methods.name: DynamicTableSizeUpdate
methods.description: Updates the size limit of the dynamic table.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a header entry into the dynamic table.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Retrieves a header entry by index from the dynamic table.

methods.name: HpackDecoderTables
methods.description: Constructor, destructor, and methods for managing static and dynamic tables.
